props.name: audioRef
props.description: The element to listen to. Its audio is routed through the analyser.

props.name: microphone
props.description: Use the microphone instead. Asks permission on the first start.

props.name: label
props.description: What it is listening to — announced, since the picture is decorative.

props.name: fftSize
props.description: FFT size. Must be a power of two; higher is more bars and more latency.

props.name: range
props.description: How much of the spectrum to draw, 0 to 1. Music lives in the bottom half.

props.name: color
props.description: Any CSS colour for the bars. Defaults to the accent.
